message.content:
Navy blue structured blazer with a relaxed shoulder cut and mid-length hem in 20°C warm wool-blend fabric, #1B283F
Cream viscose-blend midi blouse with an empire waist and elbow-length sleeves, #FFFDD0
Charcoal grey tailored trousers with a straight leg and full length crafted from soft stretch-worsted wool, #36454F
Black leather ankle booties with a low block heel and a rounded toe, #000000
Minimalist gold hoop earrings in 18k vermeil and a thin silver chain necklace, #FFD700 / #C0C0C0

This outfit works for a vocal lesson because the relaxed blazer and empire waist blouse allow your arms to move freely while you sing, ensuring comfort during the performance. The soft stretch wool trousers support easy movement as you walk between rooms or adjust your microphone stand without restriction. At 18°C, the layers provide just enough warmth without overheating, keeping you focused on your practice rather than feeling chilly. Finally, the low-heel ankle booties honor your wish for simple and comfortable footwear, giving you a confident yet effortless stance throughout the class.
